Hi Sara,

Welcome — excited to get BluePeak set up with Redwood. To get Procurement and Finance moving on a PO and vendor record, can you please provide the items below? If any are sensitive, you can upload to the HubSpot company record (link below) or reply to this thread.

Requested items (needed to create PO / vendor record):
- Certificate(s) of Insurance (COI): General Liability with Redwood Inference listed as Additional Insured (and Waiver of Subrogation, if available); Professional/E&O; Cyber policy evidence. Please include carrier, policy number, limits, and effective/expiry dates.
- W-9 (completed) or equivalent tax documentation.
- Remittance / billing contact and preferred invoicing method (email + billing address).
- Bank details or ACH form (if you prefer electronic payment).
- Completed Vendor Onboarding Checklist (attached) and any subcontractor/SOW requirements.

Target timing: if possible, can you send these within 5 business days (by Tue, 2026-06-16)? Once we have COI + W-9 we can create a PO and share the PO number. If there's anything that will take longer, let me know so we can adjust routing.

Attachment: Vendor_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf (pdf)
HubSpot company record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/BLUEPEAK

Thanks — tagging Karthik here for procurement coordination.

Best,
Stephanie
